text:
deadlock: 10 agents wait on each other in a cycle and none can move:
  orders (devin-0ae1fd440d9941fdb765f91f09a1281e) -> waits on billing (devin-289b199fe4d04db8866e6150ed40d9e8) for 1m: the invoice format
  billing (devin-289b199fe4d04db8866e6150ed40d9e8) -> waits on search (devin-ce937e44e41e4b909a30677ce381d492) for 44s: the index layout
  search (devin-ce937e44e41e4b909a30677ce381d492) -> waits on mail (devin-5f12842223a448c594291acc7a81ed16) for 59s: the template API
  mail (devin-5f12842223a448c594291acc7a81ed16) -> waits on cache (devin-38bb821961c544d598dcd16e7f214df3) for 57s: the key scheme
  cache (devin-38bb821961c544d598dcd16e7f214df3) -> waits on queue (devin-47673d273516442bb669602d4ecf55e6) for 53s: the job envelope
  queue (devin-47673d273516442bb669602d4ecf55e6) -> waits on reports (devin-b0ae158ae7fd42ae82e205a182e74215) for 1m: the metrics contract
  reports (devin-b0ae158ae7fd42ae82e205a182e74215) -> waits on audit (devin-8251f6cc85b84ad0bac968c27ed6309c) for 59s: the event log format
  audit (devin-8251f6cc85b84ad0bac968c27ed6309c) -> waits on gateway (devin-8cd4dc3f54a04bc1ae39bbdedd9c4bac) for 1m: its route table
  gateway (devin-8cd4dc3f54a04bc1ae39bbdedd9c4bac) -> waits on users (devin-d4698d5429204ea0bfb7f0ba905bd54c) for 1m: the user model
  users (devin-d4698d5429204ea0bfb7f0ba905bd54c) -> waits on orders (devin-0ae1fd440d9941fdb765f91f09a1281e) for 1m: the order schema
Every one of them is alive and healthy; the cycle is why nothing happens.
Break it: pick one edge and resolve it from outside (give the approval yourself, drop the dependency, reorder the work, or stop one agent). To stop one: `agsv send <id> "stop: ..."` then check it in Devin.
